evidence.text:
# Current detector heatmap
The current DefectRAG detector uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a nearest-normal memory bank. Its heatmap displays the cosine distance between each image patch feature and its closest stored normal patch feature. Larger distances mean a larger departure from the reference appearance. The map interpolates a 14 by 14 patch grid; it is coarse localization, not a verified defect segmentation or a named defect diagnosis. This detector does not reconstruct image features with a trained decoder. General Dinomaly reconstruction documentation describes a different method.
evidence.title: DefectRAG v2 screening and evidence policy
evidence.scope: application policy; not a factory SOP

evidence.text:
# Evidence limits and response
The system does not predict specific defect types, component counts, root causes, process parameters, acceptance tolerances or repair instructions. Those require additional validated supervision or approved process records. Model failures create an error event, never a successful inspection. Anomaly and uncertain events create local review alerts. Review source images and heatmaps before acting. Product category is selected by the operator; arbitrary or wrong-product uploads are outside validated scope. Documentation is general context and must remain separate from image measurements.
evidence.title: DefectRAG v2 screening and evidence policy
evidence.scope: application policy; not a factory SOP

evidence.text:
# Reading an inspection
DefectRAG compares an uploaded image with normal VisA reference features for the selected product. A larger anomaly score indicates a larger feature distance; the score is not a defect probability. Good means the score lies below the validated decision threshold and outside the review band. Anomalous means it lies above the threshold and outside the review band. Uncertain means it lies within a fixed five-percent band around the threshold. This review band is an operational heuristic, not calibrated statistical confidence. A Good result is screening evidence, not proof that a product is safe or meets a factory specification.
evidence.title: DefectRAG v2 screening and evidence policy
evidence.scope: application policy; not a factory SOP

serving_profile.method: Existing calibrated models; 6 original held-out images, 5 warm repetitions each; no training

protocol.method: Frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 + cosine nearest-normal patch memory; custom baseline, not Dinomaly
protocol.pixel_metrics: VisA reference 200-threshold AUROC/AU-PR; normal images included; AP separately
protocol.preprocessing: bundled DINOv3 image processor, default 224 input; no augmentation or GT masks in features
protocol.benchmark: all official training normals; all official test images; threshold-free ranking metrics
protocol.deployment: seed42; 10% official training normals held out; threshold=max held-out normal score; no test anomalies used
protocol.prior_test_exposure: retrospective benchmark: test images/results were seen in earlier modified-split experiments; no new test-driven tuning
protocol.selection_policy: fixed before execution; all three seeds reported; no best-seed selection

protocol.method: AnomalyDINO-inspired DINOv2 ViT-S/14; custom full-data adaptation
protocol.resolution: short edge448; bicubic; retain aspect; crop trailing pixels to patch multiple14
protocol.memory_sampling: per train normal: up to48 PCA foreground +16 other patches, seeded uniform cap
protocol.foreground: PCA first component threshold10; center-sign rule; 2D3x3 dilation/closing; <1% mask falls back to all patches
protocol.score: mean of top1% foreground cosine distances
protocol.fit: all official training normals for benchmark
protocol.calibration: separate deployment bank excludes every tenth content-hash-sorted training normal; maximum heldout normal score
protocol.evaluation: full official test; masks only for pixel metrics at224x224; image AP and trapezoidal AU-PR separately
protocol.selection: one fixed candidate; no test-based hyperparameter changes; seeds42/43/44 all reported; deployment seed42 fixed
protocol.exposure: retrospective development comparison; official test identities and earlier results already seen; not an untouched external test
protocol.differences_from_paper: HF encoder; image-balanced limited full-data memory; masking train and test; 2D morphology; no rotation augmentation
